ja: • 『革命機ヴァルヴレイヴ』より主役機の最強形態がプラモデル化。
• ヴァルヴレイヴIに多彩な装備を追加。装備の脱着のほか、多くのギミックを再現。
• インパクトブースターは機体の四肢に装備可能。腕部に装備するブースターは、スライド機構を搭載し、平手、握り手の２形態を差し替え式で再現。
• ヴァルヴレイヴI専用装備「アーダー・グリップ」を付属。
• 右腰に帯刀できる「ジー・エッジ」を追加。スペアカートリッジなどの付属装備は他のヴァルヴレイヴにも装備可能。
成形品×18、ホイルシール×1、組立説明書×1
en: • The strongest form of the main character from ``Kakumeki Valvrave'' has been made into a plastic model.
• Added various equipment to Valvrave I. In addition to attaching and detaching equipment, many gimmicks are reproduced.

• Impact boosters can be installed on the limbs of the aircraft. The booster equipped on the arm is equipped with a sliding mechanism, and can be interchanged with two forms: open hand and gripping hand.
• Valvrave I exclusive equipment "Ardor Grip" is included.
• Added "G-Edge" which can be worn on the right hip. Accessory equipment such as spare cartridges can also be equipped on other Valvrave.
Molded product x 18, foil seal x 1, assembly manual x 1
